name: hud_ui_timer_panel_set_elapsed_seconds
description: HudUiTimerPanel::SetElapsedSeconds stores elapsed seconds on the global HUD timer panel.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses the global timer-panel fixture.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ecc0 validates stdcall float input from [esp+0x4], loading g_HudUiMgrTimerPanel, storing to offset 0x2a4, and returning with stack cleanup.
The native timer-panel accessor smoke verifies SetElapsedSeconds stores the value at offset 0x2a4 and that GetSeconds returns the same value.
